sn22.46:1.5: yadanattā taṃ netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
sn22.46:1.12: yadanattā taṃ netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
sn22.46:2.1: evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passato pubbantānudiṭṭhiyo na honti
sn22.46:2.3: aparantānudiṭṭhīnaṃ asati thāmasā parāmāso na hoti.
sn22.46:2.8: viññāṇasmiṃ cittaṃ virajjati vimuccati anupādāya āsavehi.
sn22.46:2.9: vimuttattā ṭhitaṃ ṭhitattā santusitaṃ santusitattā na paritassati aparitassaṃ paccattaññeva parinibbāyati.
sn22.46:2.10: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātīti.
